name: tencent-fintech-neodata-cards
description: NeoData 金融卡片 MCP（WorkBuddy App 授权范围 wb-buddy-app）。用单个标的代码 + 周期 + 日期区间等结构化入参， 查询 A股/港股/美股的股票、指数、基金行情与分时/分钟/日周月季年K线、五档盘口、自选股批量行情列表、资产代码搜索， 以及热点新闻、个股本地资讯、公告、财务报告 PDF、业绩会资料（演示文稿 / 业绩发布 / 文字稿）、宏观经济日历、宏观指标搜索与时序、证券概览、基本面概览、公司资料，返回结构稳定、可直接渲染图卡。 Use when the user asks for stock/index/fund quotes and K-line charts, intraday charts, order book, watchlist snapshots, ticker lookup, stock news, announcements, financial report PDFs, earnings call materials and transcripts, macro calendar, macro indicator series, security overview with valuation percentiles, fundamentals or company profiles for A-share, HK or US markets.
